title: Northgate Optical Lab Scheduling Clause: Start of the Lab Days
content:
For a Northgate Optical job cancelled in the lab, the lab days are counted from a lab-day start. Two circumstances move that start away from the order date.

**Clause.** Where a charge was posted on the job after its order date, the job was changed and resubmitted to the lab, and the lab-day start is the date of the latest such charge; where no charge was posted after the order date but the job's prescription was issued after the order date, the job waited for that prescription and the lab-day start is the prescription's issue date. Where neither holds, this clause does not move the lab-day start.

**Records read.** The dates of the charge entries on the eyewear job — any charge, whatever its component — and the job's order date and prescription issue date. Credits are not charges and are not read here.

## Combinations

| A charge posted after the order date | Prescription issued after the order date | Lab-day start under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the date of the latest charge posted after the order date |
| yes | no | the date of the latest charge posted after the order date |
| no | yes | the prescription's issue date |
| no | no | not moved by this clause |

## Illustrations (hypothetical jobs ordered on 1 September 2025)

- A blue-light filtering charge posted on 8 September 2025, after a change to the job: the lab-day start is 8 September 2025.
- Charges posted on 1 September only, prescription issued on 4 September 2025: the lab-day start is 4 September 2025.
- Charges posted on 1 September only, prescription issued on 20 August 2025: this clause does not move the start.
